##### <a name="-opendnssec--zone--adapter_output_type"></a>`adapter_output_type`

## Data types

### <a name="Opendnssec--Adapter"></a>`Opendnssec::Adapter`

The Opendnssec::Adapter data type.

Alias of `Enum['DNS', 'File']`

### <a name="Opendnssec--Algo"></a>`Opendnssec::Algo`

The Opendnssec::Algo data type.

Alias of `Enum['hmac-md5', 'hmac-sha1', 'hmac-sha224', 'hmac-sha256', 'hmac-sha384', 'hmac-sha512']`

### <a name="Opendnssec--Datastore"></a>`Opendnssec::Datastore`

The Opendnssec::Datastore data type.

Alias of `Enum['mysql', 'sqlite']`

### <a name="Opendnssec--Denialpolicy"></a>`Opendnssec::Denialpolicy`

The Opendnssec::Denialpolicy data type.

Alias of `Enum['NSEC', 'NSEC3']`

### <a name="Opendnssec--Dnskeyalgo"></a>`Opendnssec::Dnskeyalgo`

The Opendnssec::Dnskeyalgo data type.

Alias of `Enum['RSASHA1', 'RSASHA256', 'RSASHA512', 'RSASHA1-NSEC3-SHA1', 'ECDSAP256SHA256', 'ECDSAP384SHA384', 'ED25519', 'ED448']`

### <a name="Opendnssec--Nsec3algo"></a>`Opendnssec::Nsec3algo`

The Opendnssec::Nsec3algo data type.

Alias of `Enum['SHA1']`

### <a name="Opendnssec--Soaserial"></a>`Opendnssec::Soaserial`

The Opendnssec::Soaserial data type.

Alias of `Enum['unixtime', 'datecounter', 'counter', 'keep']`

### <a name="Opendnssec--Timestring"></a>`Opendnssec::Timestring`

The Opendnssec::Timestring data type.

Alias of `Pattern[/^(P\d+[DY]$|PT\d+[HMS])$/]`
